brief.title: Jira Task Creator Tool
brief.summary: A tool that helps users turn rough task ideas into Jira-ready work items.
brief.userValue: Users can create clearer Jira tasks faster while reducing vague ticket risk.
brief.problemStatement: Users often create incomplete or vague task tickets that require follow-up before work can start.
inScope: Create one Jira task after explicit approval
userStories: As a user, I want guided prompts so I can write clearer Jira tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: User can generate a Jira-ready preview from a rough idea.
User must explicitly confirm before Jira issue creation.
openQuestions: Which issue types should be supported in MVP?
jiraReadyNotes: Use saved project key and default issue type from Jira Integration settings.
